name: InitTurningCollider
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x06: runs InitActor, then sets 0x700 to 1.0, 0x360 from D_00274B20, the vector at 0x6F0 and the 12-byte blocks at 0x704 and 0x710 from tables

name: StartTurningCollider
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x06: calls the base func_00124A48, resolves six object links (func_00124DF8), picks 0x610/0x614 from the fallbacks at 0x620/0x628 and 0x624/0x62C, loads the identity into 0x660

name: SetTurningColliderLinkFlag
evidence: sets or clears bit 2 of +0x98 in the attachment record (+0x224) of the two linked objects +0x61C and +0x618 when the record's flags (+0xB0) have 0x20; StartTurningCollider and SetPlayerState call it

name: BuildPartProbeTowardLink
evidence: for an object whose attachment record has flag 0x20, writes a probe segment from below the collider (its radius down) toward the direction of the linked object's point, of the length less 15, into the record at +0x60/+0x70 with the length at +0x80

name: KeepNearestPartSpan
evidence: when the part is active (+0x50) collects up to two spans of the object's tree between the part's points +0x70 and +0x60 (CollectColliderSpansInTree) and keeps the first one past time 0 in +0x90 when it is nearer; CollidePlayerWithObject calls it for the parts at 0x1190 and 0x1290

name: PlacePartAtProbeSpan
evidence: when the probe is set and KeepNearestPartSpan kept a span, moves the object to the span's point offset along the probe (slot 0x1D) and removes from its velocity the part along the span's normal that points into it (slot 0x20)

name: DrawTurningCollider
evidence: slot 37 of class 0x06 (the draw slot): only runs DrawCollider; DrawAgent calls it as its base

name: ReadTurningColliderStickHeading
evidence: decays the held stick level D_00274B5C by 0.25 and, when the pad's level (+0x48) is above it, takes the camera-relative heading of the stick (ComputeCameraRelativeStickHeading) into +0x630, else keeps the heading at +0x638; stores the level at +0x634

name: PlayPhaseCrossingSound
evidence: from a phase value and its previous one, when the phase crosses one of two marks in the table and 0.1 seconds have passed, picks a random sound id 0x47 to 0x4A different from the last (D_00605548), plays it at the object with func_001BFCD8 and notes the time

name: TrackFollowedMeshVertexVelocities
evidence: when a mesh is followed (+0x6DC), moves each of its own vertices toward the followed mesh's vertex in the world with the ramp D_00274B68 and stores the speed that did it in the hook's velocity array; UpdateTurningCollider calls it

name: SetTurningColliderFollowedMesh
evidence: stores the mesh to follow at +0x6DC and, for each of its vertices (or only those inside the collider's faces when all is 0), copies its world position over its own vertex and zeroes its speed, then clears the root state bits and advances the mesh motion

name: UpdateTurningCollider
evidence: slot 17 of class 0x06: runs UpdateActor then func_001C4C20

name: GetTurningColliderContactMode
evidence: slot 0x164 of class 0x06, the slot GetPlayerContactMode overrides: always 3; ComputeTurningColliderImpulseResponse uses its answer as the turn anchor's mode

name: ComputeTurningColliderImpulseResponse
evidence: slot 57 (0xE8) of class 0x06: ComputeColliderImpulseResponse with the turn anchor's mode (0x470) set to the answer of slot 0x164 for the call

name: SetTurningColliderRotation
evidence: slot 30 of class 0x06: runs SetColliderRotation, stores atan2 of the row's y and x in the headings 0x630 and 0x638 and calls slot 88

name: CopyTurningColliderMeshesInFrame
evidence: slot 0xE0 of class 0x06, its override of CopyColliderMeshesInFrame: builds the relative transform (BuildMatrixFromRotationAndTranslation) and runs the base, then moves its probe fields 0x6CC..0x6D8 into the frame

name: StepTurningCollider
evidence: slot 28 of class 0x06: runs StepCollider then func_001C5148

name: ApplyTurningColliderDrive
evidence: the drive StepTurningCollider and StepGaugeColliderAgent run: adds a force held to its anchor (ConstrainColliderVector, AddColliderForce) and turns the body toward its heading (TurnColliderTowardRotation)

name: IsTurningColliderGroundContact
evidence: slot 0x168 of class 0x06, the slot IsPlayerGroundContact overrides: with 0x6DC set accepts a contact whose normal times the side's scale (D_00274AD0) passes 0.7 and whose kind (1, 4 or 10) names the object 0x6D4 on the matching side

name: ComputeTurningColliderContactValue
evidence: slot 0x100 of class 0x06: the constant D_00274B74 when slot 0x168 accepts the contact, else 0

name: ClampTurningColliderContactLimit
evidence: slot 0x108 of class 0x06, the slot ClampPlayerContactLimit and ClampAgentContactLimit override: runs the empty ClampColliderContactLimit

name: ClampColliderContactLimit
evidence: the empty base contact-limit step ClampTurningColliderContactLimit and ClampPlayerContactLimit run

name: BuildTurningColliderHeadingMatrix
evidence: slot 84 of class 0x06: builds into the matrix at 0x660 the rotation by the heading 0x638 about the axis D_00248D20 (func_00188850)

name: ResolveTurningColliderContact
evidence: slot 0x104 of class 0x06, the slot ResolvePlayerContact overrides: runs ResolveTurningColliderGroundContact when slot 0x168 accepts the contact

name: RecomputeTurningColliderFrame
evidence: slot 18 of class 0x06: runs RecomputeColliderFrame, then stores in 0x63C the polynomial of the heading difference |0x638 - atan2 of matrix row 0| (coefficients at 0x6F0) clamped to the pair D_00275C60

name: ResolveTurningColliderGroundContact
evidence: the ground-contact step ResolveTurningColliderContact and ResolvePlayerContact run: adjusts the contact's velocity by the side's scale (D_00274AD0), limited with ClampToMagnitude and ApproachValueWithRamp

name: CollectTurningColliderContacts
evidence: slot 0x10C of class 0x06, the slot PrunePlayerContacts and CollectTintBlendColliderContacts run as their base: rebuilds contacts of the body (CreatePooledContact) and frees the dropped ones (FreePooledContactChain)

name: CollideTurningColliderWithObject
evidence: slot 0xF8 of class 0x06, the slot CollidePlayerWithObject and CollideAgentWithObject override: AddTurningColliderProbeContact with the object and its output arguments

name: AddTurningColliderProbeContact
evidence: with a probe set (0x6DC) collects the object's spans along the probe from the position to 0x6D4 (CollectColliderSpansInTree) and creates a contact (CreatePooledContact) for the first hit by its side; CollidePlayerWithObject and CollideAgentWithObject run it as their base

name: TurnColliderTowardHeading
evidence: turns the rotation vector at +0x160's third angle toward the heading of the object's x axis with ApproachAngleWithRamp and the ramp at +0x6E0, then sets it through slot 33 (0x94)

name: GetTurningColliderPose
evidence: slot 0x9C of class 0x06 (GetPlayerPose's slot): the rotation about the z axis by the heading at 0x638 (BuildAxisAngleMatrix)

name: ScaleTurningColliderRamp
evidence: copies the ramp D_00274B80 to +0x6E0 and scales its first two values by the factor and the third by the factor's inverse square root

name: SetTurningColliderGravityScale
evidence: sets the scale at 0x700 (at least 0.1), dividing the mass by the change (SetColliderMass) and multiplying the vector at 0x350 by it; a script built-in, and StartPlayer and StartAgent call it
